question: If A is the brother of B, C is the sister of B, and D is the father of A. How is C related to D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png] 

Given:

A is the brother of B.

C is the sister of B. Since A and C are both siblings of B, then A, B, and C are all siblings.

D is the father of A. Since A, B, and C are siblings, D is the father of all three children.

Family Structure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa61583acfd4a3afeb35ff849f33452b537641389eac2b14cf9474ea9a09c392.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80bafaccbd3f824f1190dede4ef7fcee09587d14b987c982f810bb0949e23f47.png] 

Thus, C is the Daughter of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
